questions.q: In a Purview lineage canvas, what do the two shapes represent?
options: Clusters and nodes in a Spark job
A dataset (rectangle) and a process (round-edged box)
Classifications and sensitivity labels
Scans and scan rule sets
questions.explain: A dataset (a table, blob, or file) renders as a rectangle; a process (the activity that moves or transforms data) renders as a round-edged box.

questions.q: By default, how many levels of lineage does the canvas render around the asset in focus?
options: One
Three
Five — the rest collapses into an expandable bubble
Unlimited, always
questions.explain: The canvas defaults to five levels of lineage; anything beyond that collapses into a numbered bubble you can expand on demand, to avoid an unreadable wall of boxes.

questions.q: What does selecting a single column in the left panel of the lineage view do?
options: Deletes that column from the source table
Highlights that exact column's path through every process and downstream target
Converts the asset into a glossary term
Triggers a new scan of the source
questions.explain: Selecting a column highlights its specific path through the lineage graph, instead of showing just the whole table's lineage.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT one of the three categories of systems that report lineage into Purview, per the lesson?
options: Data processing systems (ADF, Synapse, Databricks)
Data storage systems (Oracle, Teradata, Snowflake, via scan)
Data analytics and reporting systems (Power BI)
Sensitivity label policies
questions.explain: The three categories are data processing systems, data storage systems, and data analytics/reporting systems. Sensitivity label policies don't report lineage.

questions.q: Why is manual lineage unavailable for asset types like Azure Data Factory pipelines or Power BI datasets?
options: Those asset types already support automated lineage, so manual lineage is a gap-filler for sources that don't
Manual lineage is unavailable for all asset types without exception
ADF and Power BI assets cannot be curated at all
Manual lineage requires a paid add-on license
questions.explain: Manual lineage exists to document sources where automation isn't supported; asset types that already report lineage automatically are excluded from it.
